identityDecisions.rationale: Cobalt introduced the Coupe as a separate sister model to the A40 hard-top/open-air version, with an integrated windshield and coupe top; marketed concurrently rather than as a simple rename.

sourceNotes.note: Cobalt brochure publishes 39'6" overall with swim platform, 12'0" beam, 20° deadrise and 225-gallon gasoline / 248-gallon diesel fuel options. Runtime uses gasoline tankage as representative base value.
HMY catalogs 2015–18; Cobalt's owner archive separately lists A40 Coupe manuals for 2019–20, so staged production range extends through 2020 with medium confidence.

coverageConclusion: No additional Cobalt 40–44-foot family identified beyond the A40 hard-top and A40 Coupe variants.
sizePolicy: Hard maximum published overall length remains 50.0 ft.
